title: Try project-auto-wizard in GitHub Codespaces
subtitle: Inside GitHub  ·  No install  ·  No secrets  ·  Every step explained

steps.01-open-button: On the example repository, click Open in GitHub Codespaces
steps.02-create-codespace: Create the codespace: VS Code and a terminal in your browser
steps.03-trust-folder: Click Trust folder and continue to turn on the terminal
steps.04-terminal-ready: The terminal shows the two try commands
steps.05-install-choose: npm run try:install, then pick a sample project
steps.06-install-wizard: The real wizard runs. Press Enter for each default
steps.07-install-result: It lists the release workflows it installed
steps.08-copy-first: A real release needs your own copy of the template
steps.09-copy-template: Use the template: your account, any name, Public
steps.10-codespace-on-copy: In your copy: Code > Codespaces > Create codespace on main
steps.11-release-choose: npm run try:release shows the version each change leads to
steps.12-release-pr: It commits, pushes and opens the release PR for you
steps.13-released: GitHub Actions merges it and publishes v0.4.0
steps.14-bot-notes: On the PR, the bot wrote the release notes and merged
steps.15-github-release: The GitHub Release, written from the commit message

end_title: Your next release, from a commit message
